checks.name: All17 exact subjects expose only their own source facts and constraints
Validated documentary data remains deeply immutable
Documented larval length converts1cm to0.01m while preserving approximation
The larval source cannot size an adult boss or a different body part
A textual lower bound remains a bound and never becomes collision calibration
The vague U8 body height has no fabricated numeric value
Every documented conclusion matches only with all original-context conditions
Conclusions reject original versus remake and unrelated subjects
Every arbitrary BOW catalogue victim remains unsupported without pair-specific proof
A human worker report does not certify giant or aquatic victim morphology
Missing phase, environment, role or action conditions fail closed
Swallow attempts and impalement do not silently become guaranteed instant deaths
Held PlagaC alias, HD-only document and taxonomy conflict stay explicit
Cross-subject conclusions and promoted alias metadata are invalid inputs
Untrusted publisher URLs and direct-primary claims cannot enter the viewer
Queries leave the full source data and caller request objects unchanged

scope: Conditional source facts and dimensions, all389 catalogue victims against six constrained rules, alias/edition gates and immutable data. No original-game animation, timing or physical collision certification.
